lanes.proof_role: Patch hygiene for WP-23 release records
lanes.purpose: Verify the current release ceremony diff has no whitespace errors
Resolve local links in every changed WP-23 Markdown surface
argv: files=%x[git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACMR].lines.map(&:strip).select{|f| f.end_with?('.md')}; broken=[]; files.each{|f| File.read(f).scan(/\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)/).flatten.each{|raw| t=raw.strip; next if t.empty? || t.start_with?('#','http://','https://','mailto:','tel:','data:'); t=t.split('#',2).first; next if t.empty?; broken << [f,raw] unless File.exist?(File.expand_path(t,File.dirname(f))) }}; abort('broken links: '+broken.inspect) unless broken.empty?; puts 'links-ok'

lanes.purpose: Prove every changed or untracked path is inside the active WP-23 claim
argv: idx=JSON.parse(File.read('.csdlc/issues/4650/index.json')); allowed=idx.fetch('claim').fetch('protected_paths'); paths=%x[git status --porcelain].lines.map{|l| l[3..].strip.sub(%r{/$},'')}; bad=paths.reject{|p| allowed.any?{|a| p==a || p.start_with?(a.sub(%r{/$},'')+'/')}}; abort('outside protected scope: '+bad.join(', ')) unless bad.empty?; puts 'scope-ok'

lanes.purpose: Parse the changed JSON and YAML release records
argv: require 'json'; require 'yaml'; require 'date'; JSON.parse(File.read('docs/milestones/v0.91.7/review/wp23_release_ceremony_4650/release_evidence.json')); YAML.safe_load(File.read('docs/milestones/v0.91.7/WP_ISSUE_WAVE_v0.91.7.yaml'), permitted_classes: [Date, Time], aliases: true); puts 'structured-ok'
